+content.javascript.log_message.excludes:

diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py b/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
index 5ec8a4c..3b42d56 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
@@ -20,6 +20,7 @@
 import pytest
 
 from qutebrowser.browser import shared
+from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize('dnt, accept_language, custom_headers, expected', [
@@ -45,3 +46,50 @@ def test_custom_headers(config_stub, dnt, accept_language, custom_headers,
 
     expected_items = sorted(expected.items())
     assert shared.custom_headers(url=None) == expected_items
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('level, source, msg, shown', [
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:style', 'CSP blocked', False),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:style', 'Other failure', True),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.warning, 'userscript:style', 'Other failure', False),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'page:style', 'CSP blocked', False),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.info, 'qute:internal', 'CSP blocked', True),
+])
+def test_js_log_to_ui(config_stub, monkeypatch, level, source, msg, shown):
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.levels = {
+        'userscript:*': ['error'], 'qute:*': ['info']}
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.excludes = {
+        'userscript:*': ['CSP *'], 'userscript:style': ['*blocked']}
+    displayed = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(shared, '_JS_LOGMAP_MESSAGE', {
+        usertypes.JsLogLevel.info: displayed.append,
+        usertypes.JsLogLevel.warning: displayed.append,
+        usertypes.JsLogLevel.error: displayed.append,
+    })
+
+    assert shared._js_log_to_ui(level, source, 66, msg) is shown
+    assert displayed == ([f'JS: [{source}:66] {msg}'] if shown else [])
+
+
+def test_javascript_log_message_fallback(config_stub, monkeypatch):
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.levels = {
+        'userscript:*': ['error']}
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.excludes = {
+        'userscript:*': ['*Content Security Policy*']}
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log = {
+        'unknown': 'debug', 'info': 'debug', 'warning': 'debug',
+        'error': 'error'}
+    displayed = []
+    logged = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(shared, '_JS_LOGMAP_MESSAGE', {
+        usertypes.JsLogLevel.error: displayed.append})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(shared, '_JS_LOGMAP', {'error': logged.append})
+
+    shared.javascript_log_message(usertypes.JsLogLevel.error,
+                                  'userscript:style', 66,
+                                  'Content Security Policy blocked')
+    shared.javascript_log_message(usertypes.JsLogLevel.error,
+                                  'userscript:style', 67, 'Other failure')
+
+    assert displayed == ['JS: [userscript:style:67] Other failure']
+    assert logged == ['[userscript:style:66] Content Security Policy blocked']
